Start a game and pick level of difficulty. You can choose from Easy with 4x4 card matrix, Normal with 8x4 or Hard with 10x6. Your goal is to match cards with same picture. Guess random card. Remember it's position and then keep looking for matching one. After all cards are matched you win. Keep an eye on timer for best score.
